entities.name: San Frumenzio ai Prati Fiscali
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of Saint Frumentius at the Prati Fiscali is a Roman Catholic titular church in Rome, built as a parish church. On 28 June 1988 Pope John Paul II granted it a titular church as a seat for Cardinals.
